摘 `needs-user-decision`（无未决判断）；标记为 blocked-on-environment，key 到位后 task 1 可直接派发。

**分诊:`pm:on-hold`(三要素见下)。⚠️ 三项任务里两项前提已过时 —— 本单实际只剩 task 1。**

2026-08-03 的 PM 评论已判定「等的不是决策而是资源」并摘掉 `needs-user-decision`,**但没有换上任何 `pm:*` 标签** ⇒ 此后每轮 sweep 都把它当未分诊新单重新捞起。本轮补上状态标签,同时做过时前提检查,结果比原判更收敛。

**逐任务过时前提检查(读 `origin/main` 与已合并 PR)**

| 任务 | 原前提 | 现状 | 处置 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1 · live 端到端验证** | 需 AI Gateway 可达环境 + 有效 key | ✅ **仍然成立** —— PR #2444 正文亲自声明:完整 LLM 驱动的浏览器 e2e 需 `run-stack` + provider key + seat,CI/sandbox 不可达,故改用**真实 wiring 的集成测试**替代,并留下一份「Manual staging proof」步骤待环境就绪时跑 | **本单剩余的唯一内容** |
| **2 · cloud#817 上下文携带升级** | 待 cloud#817 落地后消费 | ❌ **已交付,前提作废** —— cloud#817 已 closed(completed,2026-07-13,实现于 cloud#819),契约定为 **(b) `parentConversationId` 首轮兑现**;objectui 消费端由 **PR #2444 于 2026-07-13 11:04Z MERGED**(`useObjectChat` 接受 `parentConversationId`、`withHandoffContext` 纯函数合并、首轮只发一次 + reload 不重发,含 5 个新用例) | 出范围,勿重做 |
| **3 · FAB 关闭 polish** | *"`FloatingChatbot`/`FloatingChatbotProvider` expose no external close control today"* | ❌ **双重过时** ——(a) `FloatingChatbotProvider` **现在就导出 `close()`**(`FloatingChatbotProvider.tsx`,`FloatingChatbotContextValue` 含 `open`/`close`/`toggle`/`toggleFullscreen`);(b) 更要紧的是 **`ConsoleFloatingChatbot.tsx` 已从 main 删除** —— ADR-0057 P3 收尾清理移除了整条 console 浮层路径,FAB 现在打开的是 `ChatDock`(`layout/ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx` + `layout/ChatDock.tsx`),**原描述的「浮层不自动关闭」这个形状已不可能发生** | 出范围,已被架构变更消解 |

⇒ 本单等价于「**在一个 AI Gateway 可达的环境里,跑 PR #2444 留下的那份 staging 走查,拿 ADR-0054 浏览器实证**」。⛔ 不改标为 `pm:queue`:它不是代码任务,派给 dev agent 只会得到「环境不可达」的空跑(#2439 授权会话当初正是被 `ai-gateway.vercel.sh` 的 403 CONNECT 挡住,**不是代码或 key 的问题**)。

**hold 三要素**

- **日期**:2026-08-06(承接 2026-08-03 的 blocked-on-environment 判定,本轮补标签并收窄范围);
- **理由**:剩余唯一任务需要**维护者提供资源** —— 一个 Vercel AI Gateway 可达的环境 + 有效 `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` / `AI_GATEWAY_MODEL`(如真实 `openai/gpt-4o-mini`)+ 一个 seat;代码侧两条已分别由 cloud#819 与 objectui#2444 交付;
- **重启条件**:**key 与可达环境到位后即可解除**,按 PR #2444 正文「Manual staging proof」段落逐步走:`ask` 问一个 build 形状的问题 → 出现「Open in Builder →」卡 → 点击 → `/ai/build` 首个 chat POST body 带 `context.parentConversationId`(ask 线程 id)、且 reload 不重发。⚠️ 解除时**只按 task 1 定价**,⛔ 不要照正文三项估工。

**建议合批**:这条与 cloud 侧几条同样「只差一次人工/真实环境走查」的挂起件(cloud#844、cloud#787 的发现 B、cloud#1020)沉没成本相同 —— 都是「安排一次有真实 key 的走查」。⚠️ 建议维护者安排环境时**一次覆盖四条**,只付一次环境成本。⛔ 本座位不代拍,仅提请。

**查重**:三仓搜 `parentConversationId` / `suggest_builder` / `builder_handoff` / ADR-0057 —— 未发现第二个仍在流通的派发入口;同批处理的 #2412(P1–P4 工单)已按 ADR Status 行自陈的 **IMPLEMENTED IN FULL** 关闭,epic #2409 已于 2026-07-14 关为 completed。

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine(#5474 试点),不构成认领。

## ⭐ CONVERTED — `pm:on-hold` → **`pm:awaiting-maintainer`**, with a `Maintainer-action:` line. ⛔ This card was never waiting on a *predicate*; it is waiting on a *person*.

PM seat `domain:devx @ objectui`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, 2026-09-13T15:18Z. objectui#8587 conversion sweep (director seat, decision batch #128 item 3).

### Why this is a state change and ⛔ not a `Restart-when:` line

objectui#8587's ruling buckets the held population, and this card falls squarely in one of them, verbatim:

> **13 waiting on a ruling** | ⛔ not `pm:on-hold`: per the six states a card waiting on a person is **`pm:awaiting-maintainer` with a `Maintainer-action:` line** …

⇒ Triage's own 2026-08-06 hold (`#issuecomment-5203720778`) already established that, and said so in as many words:

> ⛔ 不改标为 `pm:queue`:它不是代码任务,派给 dev agent 只会得到「环境不可达」的空跑(#2439 授权会话当初正是被 `ai-gateway.vercel.sh` 的 403 CONNECT 挡住,**不是代码或 key 的问题**)。

⇒ ⭐ A `Restart-when:` probe would be a **fiction** here: no `git grep`, lockfile read or pin can observe 「a maintainer has provisioned a gateway-reachable environment」. Writing one would satisfy the sweep's letter and defeat its purpose.

### `Maintainer-action:` — what is actually being asked for

```
Maintainer-action: provide a Vercel-AI-Gateway-REACHABLE environment with
                   a valid AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY / AI_GATEWAY_MODEL (e.g. a real
                   openai/gpt-4o-mini) and a seat, then the remaining task runs.
Then-do:           PR objectui#2444's "Manual staging proof" walkthrough —
                   `ask` a build-shaped question -> an "Open in Builder →" card
                   appears -> click it -> the first /ai/build chat POST body
                   carries context.parentConversationId.
Blocking-evidence: objectui#2439's authorised session was stopped by a 403 CONNECT
                   to ai-gateway.vercel.sh — ⛔ NOT a code or key defect.
```

### ⭐ Two of the card's three tasks are ALREADY DEAD — carried forward so nobody re-does them

Triage's per-task obsolescence check, which this sweep re-confirms rather than re-runs:

| task | status |
|:--|:--|
| **1 · live end-to-end verification** | ✅ **the only remaining content** — needs the environment above |
| **2 · cloud#817 context carrying** | ❌ **delivered; premise void.** cloud#817 closed `completed` 2026-07-13 (implemented in cloud#819); the objectui consumer landed in **PR objectui#2444, merged 2026-07-13 11:04Z**. ⛔ Out of scope, do not redo. |
| **3 · FAB close polish** | ❌ **doubly obsolete.** `FloatingChatbotProvider` now exports `close()`, and — more decisively — `ConsoleFloatingChatbot.tsx` was **deleted from `main`** in ADR-0057 P3 cleanup. The FAB now opens `ChatDock`. ⇒ ⛔ **the described shape can no longer occur.** |

⇒ ⭐ **The card's title still promises three follow-ups; two of them cannot happen.** That is exactly the hazard objectui#8587 exists to end — ⛔ and it is why the scope narrowing belongs in a comment a reader meets, not in a triage thread they have to excavate.

### ⚠️ The history this card records about the sweep itself

> 2026-08-03 的 PM 评论已判定「等的不是决策而是资源」并摘掉 `needs-user-decision`,**但没有换上任何 `pm:*` 标签** ⇒ 此后每轮 sweep 都把它当未分诊新单重新捞起。

⇒ ⭐⭐ **A card left with NO `pm:*` label was re-caught as untriaged by every subsequent sweep.** That is the mirror of objectui#8587's main defect: a hold with no predicate is never re-measured, and a card with no state is re-measured forever. ⛔ Both are failures of the same missing thing — **a machine-readable state.**

`pm:on-hold` → `pm:awaiting-maintainer`; `domain:devx` kept; ⛔ no `priority:*` produced — this card carries none and this seat does not grade. Terminal state read back below.
